Mühlweg 48, 35418 Buseck, Germany · [github.com/EBukin](https://github.com/EBukin)
German and Ukrainian national · born 26 January 1992

## About

Land and poverty economist with a decade of research and hands-on operational experience in
Ukrainian land markets, institutions, and valuation. My work combines rigorous impact evaluation
with the practical business of making land data usable: published peer-reviewed research on
farmland pricing, rental-market efficiency, and land valuation and taxation in Ukraine, and direct
technical assistance to the State Cadaster — including analysis code adopted as the basis for
regression-based agricultural land valuation. My current pipeline extends this into urban mass
valuation (real estate listing data combined with Cadaster and Registry of Rights records) and a
large-scale impact evaluation of land reform in Kazakhstan. I work fluently across survey,
administrative, and geospatial data (R, Python, Google Earth Engine, PostGIS), and have consulted
on the Land Parcel Identification System and mass valuation of agricultural land. Alongside my
research I have several years' experience teaching applied econometrics and impact-evaluation
methods and building analytical capacity with clients and national statistical offices.

## Work experience

### The World Bank — Washington DC. Economist (ETC2) · Feb 2025 – present

Global Poverty Department (WKPEP). Work programme:

- *Land economics and Ukraine.* Co-authored research on the Ukrainian land market; technical
  assistance to the State Cadaster; consulting on the Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS) and
  mass valuation of agricultural land; piloted mass appraisal of urban land. Implemented
  agricultural land valuation with the Ukrainian State Cadastre.
- *AI-assisted coding.* Led the Bank-wide initiative on AI-assisted coding in R and Stata. Launched
  a seminar series and internal training; delivered the ai4coding course through the Open Learning
  Campus to 600+ staff; introduced Positron and Quarto as Bank-standard tools.
- *GeoPov.* Co-initiated the Poverty Department programme leveraging microdata augmented with
  geospatial data to understand spatial income and welfare disparities.
- *Micro Modelling Lab.* Engineered data pipelines for macro-micro fiscal microsimulations as part
  of the MML standardization initiative.
- *EU poverty mapping.* Contributed to EU-wide poverty mapping; trained the Polish NSO.

References: Klaus W. Deininger; Carolina Diaz-Bonilla; Nobuo Yoshida.

### Justus Liebig University Giessen — Germany. Lecturer · Jan 2020 – Dec 2024

Institute for Agricultural Policy and Market Research. Research on land markets and institutions,
agricultural economics, rural development, and poverty in Ukraine and Central Asia — farm
restructuring and returns to scale, land market efficiency, land policy evaluation in Kazakhstan,
and resource market failures in transition agriculture. Introduced the *Applied Econometrics*
course. Researcher on the BMBF-funded ROCHADE project (CGE modelling, global trade data).

Contact: Prof. Dr. Martin Petrick.

### The World Bank. Economist (short-term consultant) · Mar 2018 – Jan 2025

Poverty and Equity Global Practice. Microeconomic analysis of fiscal incidence, geospatial analysis,
and country-level capacity building.

- *Land economics at DEC* — transparent land governance in Ukraine; papers on agricultural land mass
  valuation and LPIS.
- *devCEQ* — R package for scaling fiscal-microsimulation Shiny apps: Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin,
  Indonesia, Romania, Türkiye, El Salvador, Armenia. Capacity building in Indonesia and Georgia.
- *devPTIpack* — Project Targeting Index tools across Africa and Asia.
- *EU Poverty Mapping* — founded the wbEUPM GitHub organisation and the initial guidelines mock-up.
- *Miscellaneous* — Shiny tools for fragility and conflict risk monitoring (Iraq), spatial poverty
  explorers (Latin America, Indonesia), rural diagnostics, and the lassopmm package.

### IAMO — Halle (Saale), Germany. Researcher · Oct 2017 – Dec 2019

Land and labour relationships in agriculture, principal–agent problems and contractual relations in
Ukrainian agriculture. Led the second wave of the IAMO Farm Survey in Kazakhstan and Central Asia:
questionnaire design, pre-testing, interviewer training, QA/QC — 600 responses.

### FAO of the United Nations — Rome. Trade Economist, Statistician, Intern · Sep 2014 – Jan 2018

Trade and Markets Division: policy briefs for the WTO 11th Ministerial, bilateral trade analysis,
the Import Surges and Price Depressions review, and an R Shiny app for trade data exploration.
OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook 2017–2026: AGLINK-COSIMO country modules, meat market projections and
chapter. Earlier, as statistician: IPCC-compliant GHG estimation methodology, QA/QC protocols, and
the first emissions-intensities database in FAOSTAT.
